text:
Harper: FYI SpectraHealth trial is blocked during onboarding. Their CSV bulk user import is failing with 429 rate_limit errors from our ingestion API. Support ticket SUP-10555 opened. They have a renewal gate review in 4 days, marking priority. :rotating_light:
Neha: ugh. How many users/files affected? Any logs?
Harper: they tried to import 180 users across 3 CSVs. Logs show repeated 429s on /ingest/bulk endpoint and partial success for ~12 users only.
Harper: sample log:
```
2026-04-12T15:02:11Z WARN ingest.bulk status=429 rate_limit=burst_exceeded tenant=spectrahealth
2026-04-12T15:02:12Z INFO retrying batch=2
```
Tobias: we flipped a stricter per-tenant burst limiter last week to protect steady-state traffic. Looks like SpectraHealth's onboarding spike hit the new threshold.
Neha: timeline for unblock? Customer needs to finish invites before the review.
Tobias: short-term: we can raise tenant burst quota for spectrahealth to allow the import to complete, then revert. I can do that now and add an audit note. Medium-term: add onboarding spike profile to quota policy so imports use a transient higher burst for up to 1 hour.
Sam: can we ask support to re-run the imports after the bump? Also prep comms — want to be transparent about what we changed and next steps.
ThrottleBot: quota.update tenant=spectrahealth burst_limit=+5k for window=1h (by Tobias)
Tobias: updated. Please have them retry.
Harper: spectrahealth retried and all 3 CSVs processed; users created. Customer reports UI shows "Import complete". :white_check_mark:
Neha: thanks. Drafting customer note: short apology, what we did (temporary quota increase), plan for permanent fix (onboarding spike profile + configurable import helper), and offer a 30-min walkthrough to confirm seat/permissions. Also propose a one-time onboarding credit. Posting draft: 
Neha: "Hi Priya  we're sorry your team hit import errors during setup. We temporarily increased your account's import quota to allow the CSVs to finish while we implement a permanent onboarding profile to handle large imports more gracefully. Our engineers will add the profile within 72 hours and we'll follow up when it's live. We'd like to offer a one-time onboarding credit and can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough to confirm seat assignments. — Neha, Customer Success"
Tobias: LGTM. Remove internal quota names before sending. I'll own the onboarding profile work; ETA 2026-04-15 09:00 PT. Will include a rollback plan and tests.
Sam: Finance agreed to a small one-time onboarding credit. Please specify amount when sending.
Harper: added SUP-10555 link and import logs to calendar invite for walkthrough. Invite sent to Priya + eng contact.
Neha: customer replied: "Thanks — imports went through and we'll join the walkthrough tomorrow. Appreciate the quick help."
Tobias: tracking items: 1) Implement onboarding spike profile (Tobias) ETA 2026-04-15 09:00 PT, 2) Revert temporary burst increase after verification (Tobias), 3) Post-implementation follow-up email (Neha), 4) Walkthrough session (Harper).
Harper: closing support ticket as import verified. Marking account health: at-risk -> recovering. Renewal status: priority outreach until profile is in place. Thanks team :handshake:
